lead: `int`'s own low end is not a writable literal, so a case pinning a 64-bit bound spells it `-9223372036854775807 - 1`.
body: `-9223372036854775808` is `E0429: this integer literal is too large for `int`` — the minus applies to an already-overflowed literal. Where a field's range spans `int` and `uint`, as for `Core\Bytes::pack`'s `J`/`P`, neither refusal has a writable argument, so assert the reach at both ends.
